snippet.title: PUROMA - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
PUROMA is an incremental horror game about isolation. You are a paranoid shut-in living in a small filthy apartment. You must click through the piles of trash on your floor to gather resources and delve further into the dark secrets of your room and your own mind.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4657480/PUROMA/

Developer: HombroCabezaHombro
